O Blood and Water\nwhich gushed forth fr:

O Blood and Water which gushed forth fro: Oshagama n'amaizi ebyarugire omu mutima gwa Yesu nk'ensibuko y'embabazi ahariitwe, ninyesiga omuriimwe!
O God, by the resurrection of Your Son,: Ai Ruhanga, ahabw'okuzooka kw'Omwana waawe, Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, oshaziremu kushemeza ensi yoona. Twakushaba ngu, kurabira omuri nyina we, Omukazi Mariya, tubone kukwata okushemererwa kw'amagara agatarikuhwaho. Eki tukashaba kurabira omuri Kristo Mukama waitu. Amiina.
O Jesus, through the Immaculate Heart of: O Yesu, kurabira omu mutima gwa Mariya ogutarimu kibi, ninkuhayo okushaba kwangye, emirimo yangye, okushemererwa kwangye hamwe n'okubonabona kwangye okw'eizooba eri, ahabw'ebigyendererwa by'omutima gwawe ogurikwera, omu bumwe n'ekitambo ky'oburo bw'ekiro ky'okushaba omu nsi yoona, omu kugarukamu ekibi, ahabw'ebigyendererwa by'abanywani bangye boona hamwe n'abakwatanisa bangye, kandi okukira munonga ahabw'ebigyendererwa bya Paapa Orikwera.
O My God, I love you with my whole heart: O Ruhanga wangye, ninkukunda n'omutima gwangye gwona kandi okukira ebintu byona, ahabwokuba ori murungi munonga kandi ohikire; kandi ninkunda bataahi bangye nk'oku ndikwekunda ahabw'okukunda iwe. Nkweshengyereza ngu nkugume ninkukunda munonga omu magara aga, hamwe n'omu magara agandi kumara obwire bwona.
O My God, I thank you for all the benefi: O Ruhanga wangye, ninkusiima ahabw'emigasho yoona ei ntungire kuruga ahariiwe eri izooba. Mpereza omushana gw'okureeba ebibi ebi ndikukora, kandi ompa embabazi z'okwetomboitwa ahabwabyo.
O most gracious Virgin of Guadalupe, in: Omweshongozi w'ekitiinisa omukazi wa Guadalupe, omu kureebeka kwawe aha rushozi Tepeyac, okaraganisa kugira embabazi n'okusaasira abo boona, abarikukunda kandi bakakwesiga, barikuronda obuhwezi bwawe n'oburinzi.

Omwishiki w'omugisha gw'amaani owa Guadalupe, omu kureebeka kwawe aha rushozi Tepeyac, okaraganisa kworeka embabazi n'okusaasira abo boona, barikukunda kandi barikukwesiga, abarikuronda obuhwezi bwawe n'oburinzi. Hurikiriza okushaba kwaitu kandi otuhe okuhuumurizibwa n'okuhuumura. Twine amatsiko ngu, turikwesiga obuhwezi bwawe, tihaine ekirikubaasa kutubonabonesa nainga kututeganisa. Nk'oku waagumire naitwe kurabira omu kishushani kyawe ekirikutangaaza, hati otuhe emigisha ei turikwetenga. Amen.
O my God, because you are so good, I am: O Ruhanga wangye, ahabw'okuba ori murungi munonga, n'eky'obusaasi munonga ngu nkakora ekibi ahariiwe. Ahabw'obuhwezi bw'embabazi zaawe, ndaza kugyezaho kutagaruka kukora ekibi.
O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us: O my Jesus, tusaasire ebibi byaitu, otujune omuriro gw'omuriro gw'omu kuzimu, oteere emyoyo yoona omu iguru, okukira munonga abo abarikwetenga embabazi zaawe. Amen.

Oh my 13 Blessed souls so wise and under: Oh my 13 Blessed souls abaine obwengye kandi abarikwetegyereza, nimbashaba okukunda kwa Ruhanga ngu okushaba kwangye kugarukwe.

Tuheereze eriizooba ebyokurya byaitu ebya buriizooba; kandi otusaasire ebibi byaitu nk'oku turikusaasira abo abarikutushobeza; kandi otatutwara omu kwohibwa, kureka otujune kuruga omu bibi. Amiina.
